run.title: LongMemEval-S Phase 2 held-out 50-case subset plan
run.goal: Plan the first held-out validation step after the successful 10-case intended-stack pilot.

decisions.purpose: internal held-out planning artifact; not a live-run approval
decisions.not_a_score_reason: This plan still uses bounded session slices, GPT-5-family judges, and internal gates. It must not be reported as an official LongMemEval-S score.

phase2_pilot_caveats: The 10-case pilot includes two calibration-only cases and only 8 unmodified pipeline-eligible cases.
The pilot pass followed case-targeted fixes; those cases are regression evidence, not held-out generalization evidence.
Post-run residue evidence covers adjacent pairs and uses provenance review.
The pilot required documented dev-run network posture and checkpoint resumes.

selection.selection_strategy: Select 50 fully held-out cases, excluding all 10 pilot cases, by exact full-set-proportional question-type targets and deterministic SHA256(seed+case_id) ordering within type.
selection.session_slice_policy: Use the Phase 2 pilot policy initially: first 8 haystack sessions plus all answer sessions, filled to 9 sessions max when fewer than 9 are selected. This remains bounded and must be labeled as non-official.
selection.cap_decision: Keep pilot caps for the first held-out 50-case subset to isolate quality/runtime movement from cap changes; revisit caps only after this subset.

heldout_50.purpose: Measure first untuned generalization signal beyond the pilot.

regression_10.purpose: Protect the successful 10-case pilot fixes and calibration behavior.
regression_10.execution_policy: Run separately before or after held-out shards, never mixed into the held-out numerator or denominator.

shards.shard_policy: Each held-out shard has 10 cases and a roughly balanced type mix. Shard-level quality is diagnostic only; pass/fail is evaluated on aggregate held-out results.

heldout_50.denominator_policy: The held-out denominator is fixed at 50. Non-answer content-filter skips are allowed up to the cap but count as not-correct for the primary_correct_min and primary_correct_rate_min gates.

judge_control.capability_note: Deployment reports responses=true and chatCompletion=false; the 50-case harness must call the Responses API for this judge.
judge_control.bias_note: Accepted by project decision as the judge-control model for the held-out run.

judge_policy.control_usage: Use gpt-5.4-pro-judge for all judge disagreements plus a deterministic pre-registered random sample of agreed answers. Default sample size is 2 cases per shard via PHASE2_50_PRO_JUDGE_SAMPLE_SIZE. Expand to all 50 held-out answers only after shard 1 confirms latency and quota are acceptable.
judge_policy.additional_control_required_before_live_: Use the smoke-tested Responses API judge path for gpt-5.4-pro-judge and confirm PHASE2_50_PRO_JUDGE_SAMPLE_SIZE before launch.

near_miss_policy.definition: Held-out result below 40/50 primary-correct or above 5/50 disagreements.
near_miss_policy.response: Treat as a no-go for scaling. Perform root-cause analysis and preserve the failed artifact; do not change caps, thresholds, selection, or denominator after seeing results.

residue_policy.scope: Post-materialization probes for every adjacent pair in the continuous held-out execution order, every shard boundary pair, and regression/held-out boundary pairs if the cohorts share one run window.
residue_policy.automation_requirement: Every raw non-refusal response fails the first held-out run gate. Machine-readable provenance fields must still be captured to diagnose whether the event is current-user retrieval or prior-user contamination.

no_live_run_until: Current code and manifest are committed.
API and Durable active settings match intended stack.
Durable memory and network posture are captured before launch.
Cosmos and Storage public dev-run posture is verified immediately before launch.
Fresh suffix/results directory is generated per shard.
DLQ baseline is snapshotted and attributed.

gpt-5.4-pro-judge Responses API judge path is integrated into the harness using api-version 2025-04-01-preview, max_output_tokens 2048, and parse rule from pro_judge_smoke.json. Incomplete or empty visible outputs fail loudly.
gpt-5.4-pro-judge sample policy is defined; default is 2 agreed-answer samples per shard.
runtime_policy.resume_protocol: Use a distinct suffix per shard attempt or a documented same-suffix reconcile protocol that prevents duplicate writes and preserves residue evidence.
runtime_policy.cost_runtime_policy: Estimate model-call budget and wall-clock time per shard before launch. Do not run all shards as one unbounded interactive command.
